تشتكون (form VIII)
# تَشْتَكُونَ (taštakūna) /taʃ.ta.kuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِشْتَكَى (ištakā)
# تُشْتَكَوْنَ (tuštakawna) /tuʃ.ta.kaw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِشْتَكَى (ištakā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
